searchText: txpool_content is not implemented for blobpool yet on geth... noticed that pending blob txs weren't showing up on my block explorer https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/core/txpool/blobpool/blobpool.go#L1589-L1595 <@206016661470314496> tagging you since you were discussing the geth blob mempool in <#892088344438255616> It’s deliberate fwiw Because pulling in 80K tx shims throguh json would be extreme With blobs included thay would be 10GB raw binary So unsure what’s the best way Happy to add retrievability, but the “dumb” way seems unfeasible Do geth operators tend to expose the txpool namespace publicly? I know the beacon API has the same problem with some of its endpoints can in theory return too much data but just error instead I've been playing around with how the geth mempool currently handles mixes of blob and non blob txs. The layer that aggregates the blob and non blob tx pools currently has logic like this in several places which just takes the txs from the account in the last pool, in case of an account appearing in multiple pools. https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/95741b18448aaacacd0edd8f73a9364bd3df8c92/core/txpool/txpool.go#L356 Does it make sense for users like L2s to target this particular behavior or is it likely to change? Accounts can only be present in one pool There’s an “exclusivity” mechanism that rejects the second type of tx if the first is currently queued (blob vs nonblob)
